notes.title: RELEASE: Club Velvet Rose
notes.content:

Step into Club Velvet Rose, an adult visual novel meets point-and-click adventure, where temptation and transformation await behind velvet curtains. Explore the upscale world of an exclusive swingers club through the eyes of Hugo and Hazel—a curious couple diving deep into uncharted waters of trust, passion, and lust.

Will you encourage Hazel to chase her desires? Will Hugo maintain control—or surrender to the club’s sultry chaos?

notes.title: CVR - work in progress
notes.content:
[h2]Today I want to tell you about the current state of development.[/h2]

I've made remarkable progress in implementing the story into the game script and continuing my work in enhancing all images to 4K resolution. Below, I'm presenting images from the early part of the game (before final quality control). Be sure to watch them fullscreen to make them shine.

Despite using 4 times higher quality images, the game runs smoother, thanks to the code optimization and more competent asset management. In the following weeks, I'll be polishing this gem, trying to make every image look spectacular. I'm getting more and more experience in upscaling images, which is an excellent sign for other productions waiting in line for this therapy.

There is a significant upgrade in terms of animations. All animations rendered for the VOLUME 2 are designed as 40 frames animations and selected animations from the base version of the game will be redesigned in order to make them look smoother and sexier than before.

Also, I'm proud to announce that the quest system has been rebuilt. We have a new quest interface (too early to present it) and a slightly different philosophy behind it. It makes everything much more precise and allows you to make choices while being aware of their consequences.

In terms of the music and sound, we're starting it from scratch and trying to prepare new music and ambient sounds, together with better moaning and sex sounds. Of course, we'll keep the theme song intact.

So yes, still a lot of work ahead, but we are heading in the right direction.

notes.title: Work in progress
notes.content:
The rendering process is going great! I receive a new batch of images every week, and today, I want to share some of them with you. I was told that the rendering will be completed this year, so I’ll probably start the development at the beginning of 2025.

Furthermore, I like the MIU character a lot. She will be a worthy addition to our game cast, and together with BEN from ELEANOR, they will become key actors who play an essential role in the story.

I can’t wait to start working on this game again. I want to re-design the game flow a bit, modify the hint system, and upgrade everything to 2K resolution to impress our audience with crisper images.
